kpis.name: Total Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Sum of all operational expenses including fuel, energy purchases, maintenance, depreciation and taxes.
kpis.description: Total operating expenses increased by $191M in 2025, primarily driven by higher energy purchases (+$213M), partially offset by lower maintenance (-$176M).

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Total cost of financial debt (long-term and short-term) borne by PPL during the period.
kpis.description: Interest expense increased by $70M in 2025, primarily due to higher long-term borrowings (+$47M) and short-term debt (+$13M).

kpis.name: Ongoing Operations Earnings
kpis.explanation: Non-GAAP measure excluding special items to reflect PPL's recurring performance as reported by management.
kpis.description: Ongoing operations earnings reached $1,344M in 2025 compared to $1,250M in 2024, driven by Kentucky (+$69M) and Pennsylvania (+$33M) segments, partially offset by Rhode Island decline (-$13M).

kpis.name: Income Tax Expense
kpis.explanation: Total tax charge on PPL's pre-tax income for the period.
kpis.description: Tax expense increased by $63M in 2025, primarily due to higher pre-tax income (+$75M federal effect), partially mitigated by tax credits and AFUDC Equity.

kpis.name: Depreciation Expense
kpis.explanation: Depreciation charge reflecting wear and tear of PPL's fixed assets during the period.
kpis.description: Depreciation expense increased by $33M in 2025, reflecting the continued growth of PPL's regulated asset base, particularly in Kentucky and Pennsylvania segments.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years declared by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.285 in the last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years declared.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.794B in the last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 67.2% in the last year.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, particularly regarding rates and cost recovery. Any changes in these regulations could have a significant impact on the company's financial results (Item 1A, p. 63).

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rates can fluctuate and impact the value of the company's assets and liabilities, including pension obligations (Item 1A, p. 62).

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks related to its electricity service and financing activities (Item 1A, p. 64).

risks.title: Pension Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant pension obligations that can vary based on interest rates and asset returns (Item 1A, p. 62).

risks.title: Asset Management Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its infrastructure assets efficiently to maintain their value and generate regulated returns (Item 1A, p. 64).

risks.title: Asset Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to asset impairment risks due to changes in market conditions or regulations (Item 1A, p. 64).

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to litigation risks related to its operations and relationships with stakeholders (Item 1A, p. 65).

ai_positioning.summary: PPL does not mention artificial intelligence in its annual report. The information provided primarily concerns electricity distribution activities, regulations and compliance matters.
